svg.aria-label: Contact sheet of NATO APP-6E symbols generated by the Military Symbols Figma plugin
svg.text: NATO APP-6E (STANAG 2019 Edition E) military map symbols for Figma.
1674 selectable entities across 20 symbol sets, drawn as editable Figma vectors — every symbol below is a real APP-6E code.
digit 4 — the same infantry company, seven standard identities
digits 9–10 — an armoured unit from team to corps
symbol sets 15 and 20 — mobility rides in the same field as echelon
symbol sets 01, 05, 30, 35 and 36 — the frame follows the symbol set
Activities, individuals, control measures and cyberspace
digits 7 and 8 — drawn on the same infantry battalion
npm run preview · rendered with milsymbol 3.x, standard: APP6 · unofficial tool, not endorsed by NATO
